set.body:
Outcome
Establish the actual project/build contract without silently changing provider toolchains.

Owned scope
build.sbt; project/build.properties; module skeletons; README.md; upstream lock/provenance and license files

Prerequisites
None; first actionable task.

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Create the four module boundaries from PLAN.md; theme and workbench expose Java-friendly APIs and do not require ScalaFX or ScalaDock; only adapter depends on ScalaDock.
- [x] Pin Scala 3.7.4, sbt 1.12.14, JDK 25, JavaFX 27 and AtlantaFX 3.0.0; verify availability and exact upstream style-source commit before implementation. If a dependency is unavailable, report it rather than substituting silently.
- [x] Resolve a single compatible JavaFX base/graphics/controls/native set on the build platform; record the resolved graph and runtime versions. Default provider source resolution uses a full SHA, with any sibling checkout override explicit.
- [x] A clean native smoke application builds and exits; define documented formatting/compile/test/generation commands and retain raw exit status. Preserve all original reference asset hashes.
- [x] Record upstream MIT notices and font/icon redistribution provenance. No public repository, commit, push or publication is implied by this task.

Required evidence
Clean build/smoke log, dependency tree, runtime manifest, upstream source lock and notices; record actual command names once implemented.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code A1. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
